# Lyrenza Scottsdale Sonoran Resort

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Scottsdale Sonoran Resort is in Scottsdale, United States, in the North America region.
Facilities: Three pools; spa; desert garden; golf shuttle; kids club. Pool or water-facility hours: 07:00-21:00.
Parking: Self parking included; valet USD 25 nightly. Transportation: Scheduled golf and local-area shuttle.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
